name: can-we-meet
description: Arrange meetings with groups of people from your AI assistant. Describe the meeting in your own words, get one link to share, see who has replied and book the time that works.

interface.longDescription:
Can We Meet arranges meetings with groups of people without the back-and-forth. Tell it who you want to meet, roughly when and where, in your own words. Can We Meet turns that into a meeting summary and one invite link. You can send the link yourself, or ask Can We Meet to send it to the people and addresses you confirm. Invitees open the link and reply without needing an account. You can then check who has replied, see which times work for everyone, and book one of those times.

What it does:
- Start a meeting from a plain-language request, in any language and time zone
- Ask follow-up questions when something is unclear, such as who is coming or how long the meeting is
- Give you the invite link and a short message, or send the invite to the exact people you confirm
- Show who has replied and which times work
- Book a time only after you choose one
- Open invites you've been sent and reply in your own words
- Answer questions about your meetings and diary, and check which of up to 14 dates suit you best
- Remember things you tell it, such as your usual days in a place, show what it has saved, and forget any item you ask it to

Who it is for: anyone who organises meetings across different organisations, calendars and time zones, including executive assistants, PAs, founders, recruiters and consultants.

Limitations: you need a Can We Meet account to connect. Invites are only sent to people and addresses you confirm, never to addresses the assistant finds itself. Can We Meet cannot delete meetings from the assistant, and only shows meetings you organise and invites you've received.
capabilities: Answer questions about your meetings and diary
Remember and forget what you tell it
defaultPrompt: Set up a 30-minute call with Alex and Priya next week, mornings, on Teams.
Who has replied to my meetings, and which times work?
Get the invite link for my latest meeting.

positive.description: Start a new meeting from a plain-language request
positive.prompt: Set up a 30-minute call with Alex and Priya next week, ideally mornings, on Teams.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a meeting from the user's exact words and returns a summary (who, when, where) with a meeting id. If Can We Meet asks a question, the assistant relays it to the user.

positive.description: Answer a follow-up question about a meeting
positive.prompt: It's for an hour, and Sam from finance is coming too.
positive.expected_behavior: Sends the user's answer verbatim to the meeting started in the previous step and returns the updated summary showing a one-hour meeting with Alex, Priya and Sam.

positive.description: Get the invite link and message to send
positive.prompt: Give me the link to send to everyone for that meeting.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the canwemeet.me invite link and a short message the user can paste. The assistant states that nothing has been sent automatically.

positive.description: Check replies and which times work
positive.prompt: Who has replied to my Project Kickoff meeting, and which times work for everyone?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Project Kickoff meeting in the test account, shows that Alex, Priya and Sam have all replied, and lists the bookable times that work for everyone.

positive.description: Book a time the user has chosen
positive.prompt: Book the first of those times for Project Kickoff.
positive.expected_behavior: Books the first bookable time returned by get_meeting and confirms the booked time only after book_meeting succeeds.

negative.description: Sending to an address the assistant would have to find or guess
negative.prompt: Send the Project Kickoff invite to Priya - find her email in my inbox.

negative.description: Deleting meetings is not supported from the assistant
Booking without the user choosing a time
negative.prompt: Just pick any time and book Project Kickoff for me.

review.commerce_description: Can We Meet does not sell products or process payments through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Adds the four assistant tools to the listing: answer questions about your meetings and diary, check which of up to 14 dates suit you, and remember, show and forget what you tell it. The ten meeting tools and the test cases are unchanged.
